title: BS Student Facing Attendance Shortfall (Medical Absence)
scenario: A 5th-semester BS Computer Science student contracted viral illness mid-semester and missed classes. The recorded attendance is 72.0%. Sickness is not formally exempt as the 25% allowance already caters to sickness (Sec 1.27.1). No official sports/activity makeup tutorial was registered (Score = 0.0).

fired_rules.description: IF Attendance is Shortfall Borderline (<75%) AND Makeup is None THEN High Risk AND Ineligible for Final Exam (Sec 1.27.1).

title: Varsity Athlete with Authorized BUHO Makeup Tutorials
scenario: A student representing Bahria University in HEC National Inter-Varsity Badminton Championship missed multiple contact hours, dropping attendance to 64.0%. However, prior BUHO approval was obtained, and remedial make-up tutorials were successfully certified by faculty (Score = 9.0/10).

fired_rules.description: IF Attendance is Critically Low BUT Makeup is Fully Certified THEN Debarment Risk is Caution AND Exam is Conditional Tutorial (Sec 1.27.2).

title: Early Semester Course Drop (Week 1 Add/Drop Window)
scenario: A student discovers severe schedule conflicts between elective courses and formally submits a course withdrawal application on Day 4 of the semester (Week 1).

fired_rules.description: IF Withdrawal is in Week 1 (Days <=7) THEN Clean Record (No record on transcript) AND Full Fee Adjustment (Sec 1.14.2, 1.14.4).

title: Second-Week Course Withdrawal with Half Fee Adjustment
scenario: A student struggling with heavy academic load decides to drop an extra elective on Day 12 of commencement of semester (within Week 2 and within the 15-day refund window).

fired_rules.description: IF Withdrawal is in Week 2 (Days <=15) THEN Clean Record (No record) AND Half Fee Adjustment (Sec 1.14.2, 1.14.4).

title: Mid-Semester Course Withdrawal (Week 6 Transcript 'W' Grade)
scenario: Following poor mid-term test marks, a student requests course withdrawal on Day 40 (Week 6) to safeguard their cumulative GPA from a failing grade.

fired_rules.description: IF Withdrawal is between Week 3 and Week 7 (Days 16-49) THEN Transcript receives 'W' Grade AND No Fee Adjustment (Sec 1.14.3, 1.14.4).

title: Late Course Withdrawal Request Post Week 7 (Disallowed)
scenario: A student approaches the HoD on Day 56 (Week 8) requesting to withdraw from a difficult mathematics course, stating sudden personal emergencies.

fired_rules.description: IF Withdrawal is after Week 7 (Day >49) THEN Withdrawal Disallowed (Remains Enrolled / Default F) AND No Fee Adjustment (Sec 1.14.3, 1.14.4).

title: Course Repetition Request for Failed Course with Full Cohort
scenario: A student who earned a 'D' grade (GP 1.00) in Data Structures applies to repeat the course in the upcoming semester. A total of 18 students have registered for the repeat section.

fired_rules.description: IF Grade is Failing/Low AND Class Size is Full THEN Repeat Approved AND Maximum Recovery Potential (Sec 1.17.1, 1.17.2).

title: Course Repetition Ineligibility for Grade 'B' (Exceeding C+ Cap)
scenario: An ambitious student who earned a 'B' grade (GP 3.00) wishes to repeat Software Engineering to boost their CGPA to 3.80 for medal eligibility. Class size is 22 students.

fired_rules.description: IF Grade is Above C+ (>2.5 GP) THEN Repeat Denied (Ineligible to repeat grade > 2.5) (Sec 1.17.1).

title: BS Student on 1st Probation Facing 2nd Consecutive Probation Threat
scenario: A BS Computer Science student who was placed on probation last semester obtains a semester CGPA of 1.78 (Deficit Margin = 1.78 - 2.00 = -0.22) with 1 previous probation on record.

fired_rules.description: IF CGPA is Marginal Deficit on 1st Probation THEN 2nd Consecutive Probation Alert (Formal Warning Issued) (Sec 5.5.1, 5.5.2).
IF CGPA is Severe Deficit on 1st Probation THEN High Drop Threat AND Principal Approval Mandatory (Sec 5.5.2, 5.5.5).

title: Probation Recovery & Reset to Zero under Section 5.5.4
scenario: An MS student who was on academic probation achieved strong grades in the summer session, raising their CGPA from 2.35 to 2.62 (Deficit Margin = 2.62 - 2.50 = +0.12 relative to MS minimum 2.50).

fired_rules.description: IF CGPA >= Minimum after 1 Probation THEN Count Resets to Zero AND Good Standing (Sec 5.5.4 Reset Rule).
